content:
Andrea: Heads-up — hit ambiguous exceptions in py SDK when auth fails. 401 and 429 both surface as `Exception: Request failed (status=401)` in our quickstart logs. makes programmatic handling hard.
Sam: which sdk version? we shipped typed errors for node but not py yet.
Andrea: py 0.8.1. error object only has `.args` and a long stack. no `http_status` or `retryable` attribute.
Michael: go SDK exposes an enum + fields: `Kind` and `Retryable`. that pattern is really handy for service code.
Andrea: proposal: python `ApiError` should include `http_status`, `kind`, `retryable`, and preserve original exception in `__cause__`.
Sam: thumbs up. let's also create a canonical status->kind mapping in SDK-spec so all languages behave the same.
Lucy: important: some infra code expects `requests.HTTPError`. if we wrap, set `ApiError.__cause__ = original` or subclass `requests.HTTPError` so compatibility remains.
Andrea: rough py class sketch I plan to PR:
class ApiError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, http_status, kind, retryable, retry_after=None, original=None):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.http_status = http_status
        self.kind = kind
        self.retryable = retryable
        self.retry_after = retry_after
        if original is not None:
            self.__cause__ = original
Sam: add `kind` enum named `ApiErrorKind` in each SDK. mapping table in docs:
- 401 -> Unauthorized (retryable=false)
- 403 -> Forbidden (false)
- 404 -> NotFound (false)
- 409 -> Conflict (false/depends on idempotency)
- 429 -> RateLimit (true; honor Retry-After)
- 500-599 -> ServerError (true/depends)
Michael: note: retryability must consider HTTP method idempotency. POST on 5xx may be non-retryable.
Lucy: add `retry_after` numeric field and helper `should_retry(method)` that consults idempotency and flags.
Andrea: sample app `quickstart-auth` currently prints "unexpected error" and exits. i'll update sample to show catching ApiError and inspecting `http_status` / `retryable`.
dev-bot: deploy-notify: quickstart-auth v0.3.4 -> staging @ 2024-11-05T14:12:10Z
Sam: plan: (1) write SDK-spec mapping PR, (2) implement py ApiError + tests, (3) update samples + docs.
Andrea: i'll open python PR with implementation + MIGRATION.md snippet.
Sam: please add changelog and call out minimal breaking surface. also add example code snippet in docs showing exponential backoff for rate-limits.
Lucy: i'll update the sample README and the quickstart video captions.
Michael: tests: unit test mapping correctness + integration test where ApiError has `__cause__` preserved so frameworks that check underlying response still work.
Andrea: also propose lint rule to require setting `__cause__` when wrapping exceptions in new ApiError. small automation prevents regressions.
Sam: good call. i'll add a pre-commit check in python repo.
Andrea: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/214 (draft)
Sam: i'll review tomorrow morning. :rocket:
Lucy: on it, i'll update sample in a separate PR and reference this thread.
Andrea: thanks all — this should reduce "generic exception" bug reports and make onboarding smoother.
Michael: agree. tagging infra teams to watch for any proxy code that expects original exception types.
Andrea: follow-ups: sam review, lucy sample update, michael idempotency tests.
